Subject: MAP Kickoff: Finovo — draft & timeline options

Hi Jamie / Carlos,

Thanks again for the great discovery call earlier today — really helpful to understand Finovo's performance targets and regulatory constraints. As promised, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft that lays out proposed milestones, owners, dependencies, and two timeline options (accelerated vs. conservative).

High-level summary (please scan the attached MAP):
- Milestone 1: Technical onboarding & benchmark — Redwood provides test environment, baseline model benchmark, and validation plan (Owner: Aditya Rao).
- Milestone 2: Security & compliance review — Finovo to complete security questionnaire; Redwood to share SOC2 artifacts and evidence (Owner: Lauren Bishop).
- Milestone 3: Pilot deployment & performance tuning — pilot infra, quantization profile testing, and latency tuning (Owner: Aditya Rao).
- Target close: Accelerated target 2026-07-16; Conservative target 2026-08-06.
- Dependencies: Staging VPC access (IAM + subnet details), completed security questionnaire, procurement PO approval.

Ask / next steps:
1) Please confirm the Finovo owners for security and procurement (I have Ananya and Carlos listed as tentative owners in the attached).
2) Choose your preferred timeline (accelerated or conservative), or flag items that would push us to the conservative schedule.
3) Confirm stakeholders and availability for a 30-minute MAP kickoff next week — proposed slots below (PST):
   - Tue 2026-06-23 10:00-10:30
   - Wed 2026-06-24 13:00-13:30
   - Thu 2026-06-25 09:00-09:30

Attachments: Finovo_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx; Discovery_Notes_20260618.pdf

Thanks — happy to iterate quickly on the MAP. If it's helpful, Aditya can prepare a short pre-kickoff checklist for the staging handoff.

Best,
